raw.body:
alphaSortEntries orders the keys shown in the DevTools inspected element Props, State and Context panels. Numeric keys are meant to sort before non-numeric keys.

The bug: when a non-numeric key was compared against a numeric key, the function fell through to a plain string comparison. Keys that start with a character below "0" (like "$ref" or "#id") were placed before numeric keys instead of after them. The comparison could also disagree with itself depending on argument order, so the list could end up inconsistently ordered.

The fix returns 1 when the other key is numeric, so numeric keys always sort first, matching the existing numeric branch. I also added unit tests for alphaSortEntries.
raw.title: [DevTools] Sort numeric keys before non-numeric keys
